regions.name: This month — fictional EUR data
regions.sql: with transactions as (select 1 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 0 transaction_date, 'Salary' description, 'Income' category, 4200 amount from dual union all select 2 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 1 transaction_date, 'Freelance' description, 'Income' category, 650 amount from dual union all select 3 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 2 transaction_date, 'Rent' description, 'Housing' category, -1450 amount from dual union all select 4 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 3 transaction_date, 'Groceries' description, 'Food' category, -380 amount from dual union all select 5 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 4 transaction_date, 'Electricity' description, 'Utilities' category, -95 amount from dual union all select 6 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 5 transaction_date, 'Internet' description, 'Utilities' category, -45 amount from dual union all select 7 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 6 transaction_date, 'Train pass' description, 'Transport' category, -65 amount from dual union all select 8 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 7 transaction_date, 'Dining out' description, 'Leisure' category, -120 amount from dual union all select 9 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 8 transaction_date, 'Streaming' description, 'Leisure' category, -25 amount from dual union all select 10 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 9 transaction_date, 'Insurance' description, 'Insurance' category, -110 amount from dual) select 'Income (EUR)' title, to_char(sum(case when amount>0 then amount else 0 end),'FM999G990D00') value from transactions union all select 'Expenses (EUR)',to_char(-sum(case when amount<0 then amount else 0 end),'FM999G990D00') from transactions union all select 'Available (EUR)',to_char(sum(amount),'FM999G990D00') from transactions

regions.name: Monthly budgets (EUR)
regions.sql: with transactions as (select 1 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 0 transaction_date, 'Salary' description, 'Income' category, 4200 amount from dual union all select 2 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 1 transaction_date, 'Freelance' description, 'Income' category, 650 amount from dual union all select 3 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 2 transaction_date, 'Rent' description, 'Housing' category, -1450 amount from dual union all select 4 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 3 transaction_date, 'Groceries' description, 'Food' category, -380 amount from dual union all select 5 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 4 transaction_date, 'Electricity' description, 'Utilities' category, -95 amount from dual union all select 6 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 5 transaction_date, 'Internet' description, 'Utilities' category, -45 amount from dual union all select 7 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 6 transaction_date, 'Train pass' description, 'Transport' category, -65 amount from dual union all select 8 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 7 transaction_date, 'Dining out' description, 'Leisure' category, -120 amount from dual union all select 9 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 8 transaction_date, 'Streaming' description, 'Leisure' category, -25 amount from dual union all select 10 transaction_id, trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 9 transaction_date, 'Insurance' description, 'Insurance' category, -110 amount from dual) , budgets as (select 'Housing' category,1600 budget from dual union all select 'Food',450 from dual union all select 'Utilities',180 from dual union all select 'Transport',100 from dual union all select 'Leisure',200 from dual union all select 'Insurance',150 from dual) select b.category,b.budget,-sum(t.amount) spent,b.budget+sum(t.amount) remaining from budgets b join transactions t on t.category=b.category group by b.category,b.budget order by b.category
